decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby acknowledge the 28 day notification period and certify that on 7th April 2006 the proposed installation of two equipment cabinets and overhead feeder gantry was lawful within the meaning of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and planning permission was not required for the following reason:

The proposed development falls within the provisions given in Class A of Schedule 2, Part 24 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, "the installation, alteration or replacement of any telecommunications apparatus" and does not require prior approval.
description: The installation of 1 no. 300mm dish onto the existing base station
